prompt: Stylized 3D cartoon game environment: the inside of a cylindrical washing-machine drum seen down its axis. Glossy magenta-purple metal walls and floor covered in rows of oblong perforation slots. A very large polished gold ring arch frames the foreground; gold ring bands and rounded gold rims recede into the chamber. At the far end a round silver chrome washer door with a thick rim, a hinge latch on its right and a glass porthole showing churning white foam and blue water. In front of the door a round perforated metal platform with a copper-gold rim on short gold legs, with a folded purple towel lying on it. Four copper-gold half-dome fixtures with perforated undersides protrude from the side walls, each pouring a thin clear water stream to the floor. A glossy winding channel of water with cyan and hot-pink streaks flows in an S-curve from the platform toward the viewer, bordered by low white foam banks. Bright warm golden highlights, strong specular reflections, cool cyan glow from the water and porthole, saturated high-key lighting, light water spray.

assets.caption: The scene is a highly stylized 3D cartoon game environment, depicting the inside of a cylindrical washing machine drum, presented with vibrant, saturated high-key lighting and a fantastical, playful tone. The glossy magenta-purple metal walls and floor of the drum are consistently covered in rows of oblong perforation slots, creating a textured, almost bubbly effect throughout the entire circumference of the chamber. A very large polished gold ring arch frames the immediate foreground, seamlessly transitioning into additional gold ring bands and rounded gold rims that recede progressively into the depth of the cylindrical chamber, maintaining its opulent and whimsical aesthetic. At the far end of the drum, a round silver chrome washer door, complete with a thick rim and a hinge latch on its right side, is visible, its glass porthole revealing churning white foam and glowing blue water within. In front of this door, a round perforated metal platform with a prominent copper-gold rim rests on short gold legs, supporting a neatly folded purple towel. Throughout the entire drum, four copper-gold half-dome fixtures with perforated undersides protrude from the side walls, each continuously pouring a thin, clear stream of water onto the floor, contributing to the magical ambiance. A glossy, winding channel of water, displaying brilliant cyan and hot-pink streaks, flows in an S-curve across the floor from the platform towards the viewer, its edges bordered by low banks of white foam and surrounded by floating bubbles. Bright warm golden highlights, strong specular reflections, and a cool cyan glow emanating from the water and the porthole consistently illuminate the entire interior, enhancing its fantastical nature. The 360 scene is faultless.
